what: In the first section pinned to the screen, a full-screen large photo tied to scroll (scrub 1.2) shrinks to the size of one centered poster (width 34rem · aspect ratio .7) while settling 10rem lower, and around it poster columns are revealed and pushed in odd-even alternation, 10rem each in opposite up and down directions. The center of the surrounding shadow ring (a round gradient, pale in the center and dark outside) moves 5% closer toward the mouse each time it moves, shifted by ×40rem

options.start · end · scrub: Default top top · bottom bottom · 1.2 — the measured section is the nearest [data-fx-part=if there is a [track] (tall cell, original 300svh), that one
options.follow: Share followed with the mouse (per movement), default .05
options.rest: --fx-frame to set under reduced motion, default 1 (poster wall)
options.--fx-col · --fx-ratio · --fx-gap · --fx-: Column width (default 34rem) · poster aspect ratio (.7) · gap (2.4rem) · offset (10rem) · shadow ring center darkness (.32)
options.[data-fx-part=wall] > [data-fx-part=colu: Poster pillars — the middle cell of the center pillar is left as an empty slot for a large photo to settle into
